verdict.rationale: The evidence shows intentions have references (YOUR-REF) that can be used to link pull requests, and a CLI that lists projects, intentions and tasks. Nothing documents typing a short name to jump to a feedback item, task, or initiative. Linking a PR by reference is a different feature from navigation, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can jump directly to any feedback item, task, or initiative by typing its short name
